items.title: 6.8 Validation aur model ki behtari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of validation and model improvement (PDF 86-87).

blocks.text: Validation jaanchti hai ke model naye data par kitna achha chalta hai, training aur testing ke baad, taake us ka qabil-e-aitbaar hona tasdeeq ho. Yeh model ko sirf data ratt lene se rokti aur munsifana jaanch mein madad deti hai; validation ka feedback batata hai ke asal istemal se pehle kaun se hisse behtar karne hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Validation jaanchti hai ke model naye data par kaise chalta hai aur overfitting rokti hai; phir tuning aur tabdeeliyan model behtar karti hain, aur achhi validation use haqeeqi halaat mein qabil-e-aitbaar banati hai.

items: Validation dataset: training aur test data se alag rakha jata aur karkardagi jaanchne ke liye use hota hai. Yeh saaf aur haqeeqi halaat ka numainda hona chahiye; model is se nahi seekhta. Yeh overfitting pakarne mein madad deta aur jaanch ko zyada qabil-e-bharosa banata hai.

Robustness aur reliability: robust model mukhtalif halaat mein achha chalta, data ka shor (noise) sambhalta aur chhoti tabdeeliyon se nakam nahi hota; reliable model yaksan nataij deta hai. Mukhtalif halaat mein testing ise jaanchti aur system par bharosa banati hai.

Hyperparameter tuning: model ki settings (hyperparameters), jo us ke seekhne ko control karti hain, mukhtalif qeematein aazma kar aur validation data par muwazna kar ke badalna. Achhi tuning durusti barhati aur ghaltiyan kam karti; buri tuning model ko kam asar-dar banati hai.

blocks.title: Tashbeeh: speaker ki awaz
blocks.text: Hyperparameter tuning speaker ki awaz set karne jaisi hai. Bohat oonchi ho to awaz bigar jati; bohat dheemi ho to sunai nahi deti; sahi darje par saaf aur mutawazin hoti hai. Isi tarah ghalat set hyperparameters model ko kamzor banate hain, aur sahi qeematein use achha seekhne aur durust andaza lagane deti hain.

blocks.prompt: Validation data training data se mukhtalif kyun hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Agar model ko us data par jaancha jaye jis se woh pehle seekh chuka hai to woh sirf ratt kar achha score kar sakta hai; alag validation data dikhata hai ke woh naye cases kaise sambhalta aur settings tune karte waqt overfitting zahir karta hai.

items: Validation: naye data par alag jaanch jo overfitting se bachati.
Robust aur reliable models mukhtalif halaat mein durust rehte.
Hyperparameter tuning seekhne ki settings badalti, validation data ki rehnumai mein.
